statement: At the incumbent holding tip-speed weight 0.05 the terminal tip-speed weight is untested in the granted [0.025,0.10] domain, so an explicit two-point bracket (0.10, 0.025) is the cheapest way to test whether terminal weight moves sampled holding speed without worsening terminal or holding position error.
